items.summary: Recommendation: Continue only the six existing bounded, reversible workstreams below; keep SearchWoot private and reject new production, security-sensitive, monetization, spending, and high-priority queue work. Attribution is incomplete and direct costs are unavailable, so do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, CAC, payback, profitability, or forecasts. Which disposition should govern SearchWoot: keep private, prepare an unsent permission request, or end the public-beta pursuit?
